mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS exceeds the 50th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A dovish monetary policy stance (FEDFUNDS below 4.5%) combined with disinflation (CPIAUCSL below 3.0%) reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% and CPIAUCSL is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (strong GDP growth, GDPC1 > 23,000 billion, and high inflation, CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns due to heightened risk of policy tightening and economic slowdown over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances in the late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 > 23,000 and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1350) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 718,000) signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1350 and RSAFS > 718000.

mechanism_narrative: Higher consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals increased risk of aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.
